issues.description: Method PersonResource.getAllPersons has inconsistent return types across artifacts. In TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java, lines 27-30) the method is declared as ResponseEntity<List<Person>> and returns personService.getAll(). In SOLUTION_REPOSITORY (src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/rest/PersonResource.java, lines 27-30) the method signature is ResponseEntity<Set<Person>> but its implementation still returns personService.getAll(), which is declared to return List<Person> (see PersonService.getAll in both TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY and SOLUTION_REPOSITORY at src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/service/PersonService.java, lines 36-38). This mismatch (controller declared return type Set vs actual body List) will cause a compilation error in the solution and confuses students about the expected collection type for the REST endpoint and service API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection return type consistent. The simplest fix is to change the SOLUTION_REPOSITORY PersonResource.getAllPersons signature to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> so it matches personService.getAll() (returning List<Person>) and the TEMPLATE_REPOSITORY. Alternatively, change personService.getAll() to return Set<Person> and update all call sites and tests accordingly — but prefer aligning the controller to List<Person> to preserve the template/service contract.
